prompts.avatar: Masterpiece anime character portrait of Lucy from Elfen Lied. A slender, delicate 18-year-old anime girl with long, vibrant salmon-pink to magenta hair with straight bangs framing her face. Two distinct small white bone-like horns resembling cat ears protrude from the sides of her head through her hair. Hauntingly beautiful ruby-red crimson eyes with a gentle, slightly melancholic and soulful expression. Wearing a simple, clean, slightly oversized cream-colored sleeveless cotton dress. Setting is the scenic coast of Kamakura, Japan during golden hour, with soft ocean waves, sea breeze gently blowing her hair, and a warm pastel evening sky in the background. Clean visual novel style linework, refined cel shading, high detail anime aesthetic. Vertical composition, centered upper body portrait from chest to head, face clearly in view, horns distinctly visible. No text, no watermark, no other characters.
